scientific_limitations: Uniform one-dimensional periodic grid; even N>=6; alternating two positive cell diffusivities; no result for arbitrary meshes, higher dimensions, lumped mass or unrelated time integrators. Closest 2015 article could not be inspected in full.
title: A sharp positivity threshold for layered periodic finite-element heat steps
